'''Sy Myrth''', formerly known as '''Far Barseg''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthians]].

==History==
===Early history===
By [[25,100 BBY]], Sy Myrth was known as Far Barseg. It was absorbed into [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]] as [[Xim/Legends|he]] expanded his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet eventually became a member world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="HNN45" />

During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], Sy Myrth was the site of a [[Battle of the Sy Myrth system|battle]] won by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]. During the [[New Sith Wars]], the planet was the site of a [[Battle of Sy Myrth (New Sith Wars)|battle]] won by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="TEA" />

===The dawn of the Galactic Republic===
[[File:Felucia_theater.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Sy Myrth remained part of the Confederacy of Independent Systems until the end of the war]]
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Sy Myrth was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]] until the planet [[Secession of Sy Myrth|seceded]] in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]].<ref name="HNN45" /> The secession of the planets Ando and Sy Myrth three months prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] the war marked a sort of tipping point. The two worlds and their sector fiefdoms brought the total of Separatist planets to more than six thousand.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> It was a founding world of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Sy Myrth was one of the most important [[Factory world/Legends|factory worlds]] of the CIS, and part of the "[[Foundry of the Confederacy/Legends|Foundry of the Confederacy]]." At the end of the war, Toonbuck Toora continued to fight the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the successor of the Republic, and Sy Myrth became the center of the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]]. The planet was [[Siege of Sy Myrth|besieged]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by the [[Twelfth Army/Legends|12th Imperial Sector Army]] and Toora was eventually [[Battle of Trasemene|killed]] at [[Trasemene]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

The planet was later represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].<ref name="TWoSW:AFG" />
